about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: James Comer

pages.title: James Comer for Congress
pages.text:
## Get to know James
James Comer proudly serves Kentucky’s 1st Congressional District in Congress and is running for reelection in 2020. Originally elected in 2016, the 1st District covers 35 counties from the Mississippi River to Central Kentucky.

pages.title: James Comer for Congress
pages.text:
## Get to know James
James Comer proudly represents Kentucky’s 1st Congressional District in Congress where he serves as Chairman of the House Oversight Committee. As Chairman, Comer is leading some of the most consequential congressional investigations in American history and aggressively advocates for reducing government waste, fraud and abuse.
